candidates.description: This feature vector represents medical, clinical, and healthcare-related terminology.
This vector represents biological or medical concepts related to pathogens, disease transmission, and medical treatments like vaccination.
The feature vector activates strongly on words and subwords containing the letters "ne" or "n" related to French vocabulary, medical terms, and directional roots.
Common prefixes and combining forms used in English and scientific terminology.
These tokens are French adverbial modifiers and connective particles used to express frequency, degree, logical consequence, or emphasis.
These tokens represent the various conjugated forms, auxiliary uses, and inflections of the French verb "être" (to be).
This vector is related to fundamental biological and biochemical terms, particularly cellular structures and processes.
This vector represents adjectives and suffixes related to capability, possibility, and susceptibility.
This vector represents word-initial morphological prefixes and sub-word tokens starting with "in-" or related short strings.
This vector activates on tokens containing or sharing the phonetic and orthographic sequence "-our-" or similar morphological roots.
